description: Two Min Nan catalogs whose likely subtag is identically nan-Hans, requested through the grandfathered spelling zh-min-nan. The tiebreaker lookup key is derived from the range's FIRST subtag -- 'zh' -- while the catalogs are keyed under 'nan', so the lookup misses and lookupMatchByLikelySubtag must disambiguate by fallback-then-first instead. Here the configured fallback is the SECOND candidate, so 'first candidate' and 'fallback' disagree.
